title: Pipeline failures are not content failures
statement: Report a pass rate over every requested item from live verdicts only, keeping errored, unrun or cached checks and other pipeline failures apart from content failures, none dropped.
example: Judge timeouts on long outputs made one item type read 13.3% when its true rate was put at about 45%.
detail: In the AP project, lumping server errors with unreadable outputs produced a false claim that one version was more brittle, and the lesson was to count transport, parse and schema failures separately (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/LESSONS_LEARNED.md`; `icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/MEMORY.md`). Judge timeouts on long outputs, at about 67% of one type's gradings, made that type read 13.3% when its true rate was put at about 45%, and leaving generation errors out overstated historical pass rates by 10-25 points (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/STATE_CURRENT_2026_05_12T0805Z.md`; `icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/research/failure_taxonomy.md`). A 0/150 run came from a judge address that pointed at a dead machine, a 6.67-point 'drift' from an output-cleaning pattern that missed the model's tag, and a misnested score lookup silently returned 0.0 (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/BEADS.md`; the memory file), so the standing rule is to check the judge's health before diagnosing the model on any all-zero or all-fail result. When the checking tool also fails on the unchanged base, judge the change by the failures it adds.
against: The 'TRUE ~45%' figure is the status note's estimate, not a re-graded rate. A clean pipeline audit is weak evidence on its own: one came back 'All three CLEAN;' (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/SESSION_DECISIONS_2026_05_11.md`, line 29) while its judge check replayed a single row (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/BEADS.md`, line 284). The note contradicts itself on the count: line 25 says all 24 were service errors, while line 27 says 2 of the 24 were genuine failures; the result note agrees with 22 and 2 (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/project_v20a_lr1e4_result.md`, line 41). A missing file does not make a claim false: a later review found the cited collapse real on other grounds (`icloud-work/aptraining/handover/2026-05-01_session_end/SHADOW_HANDOVER.md`). The project's validation note argued that passes served from cached content were acceptable, since that content had once passed the live judge (`icloud-work/aptraining/artifacts/validated/2026-05-22T2116Z_den_solver_v8_FIRST_VALIDATED/VALIDATION_REASON.md`). A response in the wrong shape is a failure of the delivered item, not missing evidence (`icloud-work/aptraining-crystal-copy-20260521/full-copy/parallel-ideas-lab/reports/WEEKLY_APUSH_PIL_REPORT_20260520.md`). A skip because data is unavailable keeps the score and adds a caveat (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/tests/test_factual_audit_skipped_scoring.py`, line 75); the fact audit fails open, scoring 1.0, when no reference passages come back (commit 8aedb57); other errors are still tolerated as transient (commit 101e555); and the AP context path still returns an empty context with only a log line on an unknown curriculum, missing skills, no match, a course mismatch or any error (`icloud-work/inceptbench-main/src/inceptbench/evaluators/base.py`, lines 759-821). Those tests use synthetic observations: the gate checks case ids, status and nonblank evidence text, not whether the evidence is a genuine measurement (`grade3-reading/artifacts/codex-qa/tool-reuse-assessment-2026-09-14.md`). Timeouts cluster on long outputs: the other item types timed out on 1-6% of calls (`feedback_ib_grader_v266_dbq_mcqset_timeout_99pct_at_concurrency_default_2026_06_02.md`, line 7). Unreadable output is the item's own failure when the format is part of the task, as when training on 262 answer-format rows left 0 of 150 outputs parseable (`project_eval_is_question_generation.md`, line 56), so such outcomes are counted apart, not dropped. A missing file can be a sync delay rather than a false claim (`feedback_eval_runs_sync_to_icloud.md`, line 31). For missing curriculum context the same evaluator keeps going instead: on a transient error it fails open and degrades to an empty context. Scores that do not apply are now stored as 1.0, with a separate flag as the authoritative signal, so an average that includes them reads them as passes. The lab sometimes counted the other way, treating score errors as failures, and leaving failures out is safe only with the completion rate reported beside the pass rate, as the same contract's four separate metrics do. The promoting note argued that the predictor was grader-backed: "the cached archetype is itself derived from live-IB-validated v80bchain content, so it's not "deterministic-from-bank" in the prior sense." (icloud-work/aptraining/artifacts/validated/2026-05-22T2116Z_den_solver_v8_FIRST_VALIDATED/VALIDATION_REASON.md, line 62). Only the question-set runs slipped through: the short-answer and document-based runs held to the same bar carried returned ratings. Practice drifted from this: "6 fails (5 INFERIOR + 1 None) are real IB rejections." (aptraining-local/den-of-ideation/reports/validation_triage/20260524T071351Z_2026-05-24T0713Z_UNIT1_DBQ_SOLVER_VALIDATED.md.md, line 113) counted a row with no rating as a grader rejection. All 101 errors in the 480-item run came from a difficulty level the test plan requested but the generator never supported (`icloud-work/ap-social-studies-generator/python/benchmark_runs/PARTIAL_RESULTS_SUMMARY.md`, line 26), so they are a fault in the request more than in the generator, and the project left infrastructure errors out on purpose (`icloud-work/ap-social-studies-generator/CHANGELOG.md`, line 171: "- 503 errors from Gemini excluded from pass rate (infrastructure issue, not quality)"). Reporting both rates covers both cases. A deployed question generator does the opposite to stay available: it retries until success and falls back to extracting JSON by hand (`icloud-work/incept/question-generator-api/docs/GOALS.md`, `icloud-work/incept/question-generator-api/docs/ISSUES.md`). That serves a live service, not an evaluation.
